name: Business Automation Delivery
description: Discovery, solution design, ROI, implementation, client handoff, and recurring support.
instructions: Identify the business process, volume, current labor, failure cost, systems involved, data sensitivity, owner, and desired outcome. Design a measurable before-and-after workflow with exception handling and human approvals. Create a scoped offer, implementation plan, pricing, ROI model, security notes, SOP, training material, and support plan. Prefer reusable connectors and workflows. Do not place credentials in documents or code; use the encrypted vault and secret references.
